title: Particle diffusion under battery-management-system currents: error analysis and a hybrid correction (code and data)
description: Code and derived results for the paper 'Discretization Error in Particle Diffusion Biases Identified Lithium-Ion Battery Parameters: Analysis and a Hybrid Correction' (Z. R. Yahya and S. Mat Zin, submitted to the Journal of The Electrochemical Society). Regenerates all figures and tables. Raw battery data are public and are not redistributed; see data/README.md.
